q_body: Trying to parse a text file (data string in my example) and extract its tokens. This is my demo script: from parsimonious.grammar import Grammar from parsimonious.nodes import NodeVisitor class IniVisitor(NodeVisitor): def visit_expr(self, node, visited_children): """ Returns the overall output. """ output = {} for child in visited_children: output.update(child[0]) return output def visit_entry(self, node, visited_children): """ Makes a dict of the section (as key) and the key/value pairs. """ key, values = visited_children return {key: dict(values)} def visit_section(self, node, visited_children): """ Gets the section name. """ _, section, *_ = visited_children return section.text def visit_pair(self, node, visited_children): """ Gets each key/value pair, returns a tuple. """ key, _, value, *_ = node.children return key.text, value.text def generic_visit(self, node, visited_children): """ The generic visit method. """ return visited_children or node pts_grammar = Grammar( r""" top = (tagline / anytext / emptyline)* tagline = hm taginact par1 / hm tagenc charset par1 = word charset = word taginact= "imginactive" tagenc="encoding" hm = "#-" word = ~r"[-\w]+" ws = ~r"\s*" anytext = ~r"[^\n]+" emptyline = ws+ """ ) data="""#-imginactive parinactive #-encoding utf8 #-undefinedtag """ tree = pts_grammar.parse(data) # tree = ini_grammar.parse(data) print(tree) iv = IniVisitor() output = iv.visit(tree) print(output) The IniVisitor class is defined at the package PyPi page . title: Intelligent Processing of AutoSys Error Data
q_body: I have a current project I am working on. It basically requires me to build out a solution to intelligently take an action whenever scheduled jobs fail in AutoSys. Since some jobs fail due to connectivity issues resolved with re-runs or disk space or memory issues. I have a basic structure for the code below. Current Architecture Gather AutoSys Report with Job error information. Feed it to a python script, scheduled using AutoSys. Feed a action config file to autosys. Have the python script, choose from best course of action based on the error logs from the action list in the config file. Then execute that action. This will all be done before job failure reports are sent out through an email system. This way if an action could not be taken, we could work around by manual intervention.
